hero_katana.name: SM_Nyaagyu_HeroKatana
hero_katana.authorship: Original geometry, material graphs and lighting authored for SORA Arena by procedural Blender script; no third-party source meshes or textures
hero_katana.license: Original project-owned artwork; no purchased assets
hero_katana.units: Blender meters; FBX converts for Unreal centimeter import
hero_katana.materials: Physically based Principled BSDF source materials, with metalness/roughness and subtle procedural surface variation; author matching Unreal material instances on import
hero_katana.runtime_export: Drawn katana only; the separately modeled saya remains in the editable Blender source and review renders
hero_katana.projection_uv: Dominant-normal planar UV, four repeats per source meter; present on every modeled part
hero_katana.scope: Detailed drawn hero katana with separate non-runtime saya source. This does not establish game-wide photorealism or verify Unreal rendering.
